_about: The complete vocabulary a World Bible race card can trigger in Pathfinder GM. Generated by tools/export_race_cues.py from rules/races.py — do not edit by hand.

size_words.small: small, short, slight, diminutive, half the height, child-sized, waist-high, knee-high, halfling-sized
size_words.large: towering, giant, huge, massive, twice the height, ten feet, nine feet, eight feet — RECOGNISED BUT NOT GRANTED: the Race Builder allows Large for giants only, so the sheet stays medium and a not_yet line is written

speed_words.fast: swift, fast, quick, fleet, sprint, outrun, rapid

ability_rule: exactly two strengths and one weakness, all from ability_words, the weakness not also a strength — otherwise the whole array is ignored and the race keeps the generic +2 physical / +2 mental / -2 any

cues.write: wings, winged, fly, flight, glide, soar, airborne
cues.example: They have broad wings and fly between the canopy platforms.
cues.waits_on: a fly speed: the engine moves on the ground only

cues.example: They hunt by echolocation, and the dark costs them nothing.

cues.write: one of see / sight / vision / eyes WITHIN FORTY CHARACTERS of one of dark / darkness / night / lightless / pitch — or the single words darkvision / nightvision
cues.example: They see in pitch darkness as well as in daylight.

cues.write: dim light, low light, low-light, twilight, dusk
cues.example: They see clearly by dusk light and hunt in the last of it.

cues.write: one of scent / smell / olfactory / nose WITHIN FORTY CHARACTERS of one of keen / sharp / track / hunt / acute / strong — or the phrases "track by scent" / "hunt by smell"
cues.example: They track by scent over open ground.
Gills at the throat let them breathe underwater.
cues.note: grants TWO tags: amphibious and a swim speed
cues.waits_on: a swim speed: the engine has no water

cues.example: They climb sheer trunks without rope.
cues.waits_on: a climb speed: the engine has no walls

cues.example: They dig through packed earth to move between chambers.
cues.waits_on: a burrow speed: the engine has no earth

cues.example: Each hand ends in heavy claws.
cues.waits_on: natural attacks: the engine rolls the weapon in hand

cues.write: fang, fangs, bite, tusk, tusks, mandibles, beak
cues.example: A hooked beak, strong enough to break bone.
cues.waits_on: natural attacks: the engine rolls the weapon in hand

cues.write: carapace, chitin (any ending), scale, scales, scaled, hide, armour, armored, plated, shell
cues.example: Overlapping scales cover the back and shoulders.

cues.write: one of light / sun / sunlight / daylight WITHIN FORTY CHARACTERS of one of pain / blind / burn / dazzle / hurt / weak (any ending)
cues.example: Direct sunlight dazzles them within moments.
